# Hands-On 3: Django REST Views, URL Routing & DRF

## Setup
```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
python manage.py makemigrations
python manage.py migrate
python manage.py runserver
```

## Endpoints (auto-generated by DefaultRouter)
- GET/POST      /api/courses/
- GET/PUT/PATCH/DELETE  /api/courses/{id}/
- GET           /api/courses/{id}/students/   (custom @action)
- GET/POST      /api/students/
- GET/POST      /api/enrollments/

## Test
```bash
curl http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/courses/
curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/courses/ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"name":"Data Structures","code":"CS101","credits":4,"department":1}'
curl http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/courses/1/students/
```

## Files
- `courses/serializers.py` — ModelSerializers for all 4 models
- `courses/views_task1_apiview.py` — Task 1 reference: APIView-based CourseListView/CourseDetailView
- `courses/views.py` — Task 2 final: ModelViewSet-based CourseViewSet/StudentViewSet/EnrollmentViewSet with custom `students` action
- `courses/urls.py` — DefaultRouter wiring
